goal:
Add the following recipes into the Broccoli app:
title|description|servings|preparationTime|ingredients|directions
Chicken Alfredo Pasta|An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.|1 serving|2 hrs|n/a|Cook fettuccine pasta, toss with Alfredo sauce and grilled chicken strips. Serve with a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Pesto Pasta with Peas|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|1 serving|1 hrs|to preference|Cook pasta, stir in pesto sauce and cooked peas. Add Parmesan cheese before serving. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
Cauliflower Fried "Rice"|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|6 servings|45 mins|to preference|Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice. Sauté with vegetables, soy sauce, and add scrambled eggs. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
summary:
I added all three recipes to Broccoli. After saving each one, I checked that every field matched your table exactly.

- **Chicken Alfredo Pasta:** 1 serving, 2 hrs, ingredients "n/a".
- **Pesto Pasta with Peas:** 1 serving, 1 hrs, ingredients "to preference".
- **Cauliflower Fried "Rice":** 6 servings, 45 mins, ingredients "to preference". The quotes in the title and the "é" in "Sauté" came through correctly.

Broccoli already had a recipe called "Pesto Pasta with Peas" with a different description. I left it alone, so there are now two recipes with that name.

To type the "é", I had to turn on the phone's "Show virtual keyboard" setting. It's still on, so the on-screen keyboard will show even when a physical keyboard is in use. You can switch it off again from the keyboard picker.
